recap.text: Bautista is the sole survivor of his brothers, sisters, and cousins. He finds Former Circus Lemurs and a secretary dead and swears a debt to a cat and a man with no shoes. He points them to a stairwell three kilometres east and asks how they make it to heaven if God does not recognise them. Bautista is the first of his group down the stairs to the fourth floor.

Bautista learns Imani wants to talk about Brandon and Chris at the Desperado Club. He uses a purple Voca Nye to stop a snake woman from hypnotizing his group. Bautista helps Carl match lines to carts near the pit and warns him that a city boss in trainyard E resists magic. Bautista uses stuffed monsters from Jaxbrin Amusements, but Carl tells him to train with his sword.
Bautista clears all four castles in his bubble. He reports this in the chat. Most people in the bubble did not survive.

Bautista uses uncommon fuzzy mousers with sunglasses, false tiaras, and tame spells to fool Lucia and Vrah. He and Tran train as swashbucklers for a team bonus. Carl tells Bautista he approves of Katia and Bautista. Katia goes after Eva with Li Na, while Bautista helps with rescues and healing. Katia and Bautista tell each other they love each other.

Bautista paces while Carl tastes tea. Bautista tells Katia he does not like the attendant boon and asks why a goddess puts so much effort into her. Bautista tells Carl that Katia is out of sorts after finding a merchant in the Desperado Club. Bautista pushes Katia into a chair, but she stands to leave with Carl. Bautista tells them to kill themselves and leaves the club.

Bautista finishes devices in the crafting room and carries them into a tent. The goddess says Katia's wish for the father cannot be, so they fasten on parts Katia made herself. Before the stairwell, Bautista tells Carl he would not hurt a brother like him. He warns Carl that the Kimaris figure has a summoning time of the remainder of the floor.
Bautista pours tea one cup at a time for two hundred people in the main square at Hungry Eyes with Linus at his elbow. Tran and Zhang take their cups. Nobody hurries him or says the obvious thing.

beats.headline: A name on a dead boss
beats.text: There is a level seventeen neighbourhood boss rotting in an empty swimming pool, and the kill notice carries my name. I had four brothers and sisters and fifteen cousins, and I am all that is left of any of them. So I hunt, and the notice carries my name and nothing else, which is accurate.
beats.gist: Daniel Bautista is the sole survivor of four siblings and fifteen cousins.

beats.headline: He thanks the two who took his revenge
beats.text: My sisters and a cousin, five of them, went in seconds to Former Circus Lemurs; I was with my other cousin, and we barely got away. He gave up, and the next day he was gone. Now I walk out of the crowd to find the lemurs already dead by somebody else's hand, and the secretary I had a quest to kill dead by the same hand, and none of it mine. So I swear a debt to a cat and a man with no shoes, give them my chat contact, and point them at a stairwell three kilometres east. Then I ask the man the question I cannot answer for myself: how can we make it to heaven if God does not recognise us?
beats.gist: Daniel Bautista swears a debt to a cat and a shoeless man after they kill lemurs.

beats.headline: I told you it was here
beats.text: I told them there was a stairwell three kilometres due east of the village. Now the whole district is running for it, and I jog up with a new group behind me while the timers run down. I told you it was here, I say. The man with no shoes, in nothing tonight but a jacket, claps me on the shoulder. I nod to him, and I am the first of us down the stairs to the fourth floor.
beats.gist: Daniel Bautista tells others a stairwell is three kilometres east of the village and enters the fourth floor.

beats.headline: Imani is looking for you
beats.text: Hey man, you free? I got a message for you. I'm at the Desperado Club, and I just met a guy who's in contact with a woman named Imani. She needs to talk to you. Says it's super important, something about a Brandon and a Chris. She'll try to be at the bar each night after the recap. And be careful, man. I heard a few guys talking about hunting down the leaderboard for the bounty, and I don't think this bar is a saferoom. The trick to finding the club: a transfer station whose number ends in one.
beats.gist: A man tells Bautista that Imani wants to talk about Brandon and Chris at the Desperado Club.

beats.headline: The purple Voca Nye
beats.text: The Kravyad at 435 is no boss. She is a snake woman with many arms, just as Carl was told. She tried to hypnotize us, and I used my last Voca Nye, the purple variant, and her spell would not come. Now she has nothing left but the threat to kill herself if we come any closer, and if she dies, the portal dies with her. One of our brothers was a police negotiator, and he talks to her through the doorway. Fewer than half of us still have our hats.
beats.gist: Bautista uses a purple Voca Nye to stop a many-armed snake woman from hypnotizing them.

beats.headline: The portal closes at 435
beats.text: We tried to paralyze the Kravyad, and she died, and the portal closed. More than a hundred and fifty of us have no souvenir hat. A man at the bar bragged about what they were fetching, and a bunch of us sold them. I have none. The trains have stopped on every track. We are walking to the abyss portal, about fifty kilometres. Carl says to send those with hats through, and to look for a way to station 436, where the named lines run.
beats.gist: Bautista walks fifty kilometres to the abyss portal because the trains stopped on every track.

beats.headline: Three groups at the pit
beats.text: Somebody has found the Sinopia line, about five levels deeper than most of us, and there is a group down there. For mine, a gangway leads up one level to the Mindaro line. It still stands, but the Wall Monitors are gathering near it, and we will have to fight our way up. One more group is heading for the Grullo line. I think that is everybody. Carl and I spend two hours matching lines to his carts, and I tell him the tunnels open out near the pit, so the people there can step clear of the first cart.
beats.gist: Bautista tells Carl the tunnels open near the pit so people step clear of the first cart.

beats.headline: Six hundred at the end of the line
beats.text: Carl steps off a cart with a portal on its nose, and I tell him the truth: you have saved us. Again. Then he tells me he has sent the station mimic to trainyard E, where his own cart points. I have fought that city boss. Cut a piece off and it becomes a spider and crawls back to the whole; bashing does nothing; it resists magic. I do not know how to kill it, and I say so. He has hats enough for all six hundred of us, so we go through the great portal to yard H instead. Thank God for plan B.

beats.headline: The Jaxbrin babies
beats.text: Jaxbrin Amusements sponsors me, the same people who make my babies. Stuffed monsters: pull the tag like a grenade, throw it, and in ten seconds something real is fighting for you, or now and then against you. A green Slizzer attacked me once. Miss Quill had more than a thousand of them in her apartment, and I took them all. I have used about forty. I raise it with Carl because I have been meaning to ask whether he has any, and because I am afraid of running out. He tells me to train with my sword. He is right.
beats.gist: Daniel Bautista takes over a thousand stuffed monsters from Miss Quill's apartment.

beats.headline: All four castles, and the cost
beats.text: All four castles in my bubble are cleared. I report it in the chat. Most of the people in the bubble did not survive to see it done. How that sits with me is not the kind of thing a chat window was made for, so I leave it out.
beats.gist: Daniel Bautista clears all four castles in his bubble and reports it in the chat.

beats.headline: Five hundred beanies left
beats.text: The ruse used one of my uncommon mousers, fuzzier than the common kind, with the sunglasses and the false tiara, and a tame spell on it, because they attack when I pull the tag. The Princess says it looks nothing like her. It fooled Lucia and Vrah both. I have about five hundred left. My sponsor sent a refresher kit, and I can re-tag the ones that survive being summoned, twice. Tran and I are both swashbucklers now. We train together, and we get a bonus as a team.
beats.gist: Bautista uses fuzzy mousers with sunglasses and false tiaras to fool Lucia and Vrah.

beats.headline: Carl says he approves
beats.text: Carl tells me he approves of Katia and me. I did not know how much I needed to hear it until it was said out loud, and I am ashamed of how relieved I am. I admit I had worried he had a thing for her himself. He says she is like his sister.
beats.gist: Carl tells Daniel Bautista he approves of Daniel and Katia, who Carl says is like his sister.

beats.headline: I love you, Daniel
beats.text: Katia is going after Eva, and I say I will come. No, she says. Help with the rescues and the healing; Li Na will be with her. I am uncertain, but I relent. Li Na is a good bodyguard. Be careful, I tell her. Do it quick. She tells me she loves me, and I tell her I love her too. Before the party, when she was frightened of what she is, I told her it was okay. She is stronger than she thinks.
beats.gist: Katia goes after Eva, and Daniel Bautista tells her he will come.

beats.headline: He asks why she cares
beats.text: I cannot keep still, so I pace. Carl tastes the tea and says it is really good, and I nod. Katia wants the attendant boon, and I say it first: I do not like it. Mordecai explains what the twelfth floor does to attendants. Katia says the goddess has promised to protect her, and that the other gods have better things to do than worry about a single crawler. Then I ask the only question I have. Why is this one putting so much effort into you? When Carl looks up from the slip of skin, I meet his eyes.
beats.gist: Bautista paces while Carl tastes tea. Bautista tells Katia he does not like the attendant boon.

beats.headline: Just leave it
beats.text: Carl writes to ask where Katia is. She is asleep, and she is safe. She found a merchant hidden somewhere in the Desperado Club, and she is out of sorts. I tell him their operation will have to wait a day, because she will not be ready. He wants to come. He wants to send Imani. We are still inside the club. I ask him to leave it. She will be fine.
beats.gist: Bautista tells Carl that Katia is safe and asleep in the Desperado Club.

beats.headline: I won't stand by and watch
beats.text: Carl wants her on her feet now, sick as she is, for whatever the two of them have planned. I push her back down into the chair, and she tells me never to touch her like that. There will be time for it, I tell him. There may be ways into the club in phase two. She stands with him anyway. Fine, then. Kill yourself. But I will not stand by and watch it. I leave the club.
beats.gist: Daniel Bautista pushes a sick woman into a chair and leaves the club.

beats.headline: I got them done
beats.text: I am in the crafting room, finishing something. Carl messages that I am running out of time. I am coming. When I walk into the tent with the devices in my arms, they all tense. I got them done. Oh, Daniel, she says. I didn't think you knew. Of course I knew. I love you. I am sorry I made you doubt me. The goddess says she sees who Katia wishes the father to be, and it cannot be so. When Katia is human again, we fasten on the parts she made herself.
beats.gist: Daniel Bautista finishes devices in the crafting room and brings them to Katia in a tent.

beats.headline: A brother like you
beats.text: I stop beside Carl before the stairwell. I know he thought I would do something horrible, or jealous. I almost did. I keep losing family, and it makes me scared, and it makes me angry. I am not considered human anymore, and that is my great shame, today most of all. But I would never do anything to hurt a brother like him. One more thing: the Kimaris figure he carries is one of the brothers of Sheol, with a summoning time of the remainder of the floor. Be careful with him. I go in.
beats.gist: Daniel Bautista stops beside Carl and tells him he would not hurt a brother.

beats.headline: Tea for two hundred, in the square
beats.text: Two hundred of us are going, and before we go I am pouring in the main square at Hungry Eyes with Linus at my elbow, one cup at a time. My family always held that serving friends is a holy thing, and I tell my friends so: in honouring them, we were honouring God. Tran takes his cup. Zhang takes his. Nobody hurries me and nobody says the obvious thing, which is the kindest they have ever been.
beats.gist: Daniel Bautista pours tea for two hundred people in the Hungry Eyes main square with Linus.

relations.note: He sets his hat down in front of her, and four hundred crawlers do the same.
